Profile
Research/Clinical Interests
Research interests include radiation treatment planning and delivery; use of radiation therapy to treat cancer and non-neoplastic/inflammatory diseases; feline oncology.
Education
2005-2007: Cornell University, Resident in Radiation Oncology
1999-2001: University of California, Resident in Medical Oncology
1997-1999: Louisiana State University, Resident in Small Animal Internal Medicine
1996-1997: The Animal Medical Center, Intern in Small Animal Medicine and Surgery
1996: Louisiana State University, Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
Biography/Professional Experience
Dr. Gieger is a native of New Orleans, LA and is a 1996 DVM graduate of Louisiana State University. She is board-certified in small animal internal medicine and oncology (ACVIM) and radiation oncology (ACVR). Her primary role at Cornell is as a Clinical Professor of Radiation Oncology. Her research interests include prospective and retrospective studies that further define the role of radiation therapy for cancerous and non-cancerous/inflammatory diseases in cats and dogs. She also serves as the Examination Director for the American College of Veterinary Radiology, Specialty of Radiation Oncology.
